decision.observation: The car is inside a large blue puddle at 3 mph, gear 1, four dots lit blue, no red X. The checkered 'Nimkaddel' gantry spans the lane up-screen ahead, with barrels, flags and 'Petrol'/'STOPP' banners along the right verge; the wet patch covers most of the lane width here.
decision.hypothesis: Puddles only slow the car rather than stopping it, so sustained throttle should carry it through and out onto the dry tarmac at the arch.
decision.memory: This is the same Nimkaddel gantry seen near the start — the route looks to be a closed loop back to it. Blue dots light up in puddles and fade once on dry tarmac.
